controls_spec.name: prfB N-terminal extension
controls_spec.reason: PrfB (RF2) is essential; its N-terminus is made by a programmed +1 frameshift that Bakta cannot model, so peptides upstream of Bakta's start are true by biology

controls_spec.name: infC late start
controls_spec.reason: IF3 starts at the AUU codon upstream of Bakta's later ATG/GTG start; peptides there are true N-terminal sequence

controls_spec.name: PrdB read-through (Sec)
controls_spec.reason: PrdB is a selenoprotein; translation continues through the UGA (Sec) codon
